evidence.detail: The class is instantiated exclusively by LoadoutItemIconCache into its five-worker array.
Its item-id task renders the exact 32x32 item sprite, converts the image, wraps it in rs/gui/x, stores it in LoadoutItemIconCache's ConcurrentHashMap and requests UI refresh.
It owns no loadout persistence or selection state; its entire live role is producing cached item icons from item ids.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the item-icon loader used by the loadout icon cache.

evidence.detail: R143 LoadoutPersistence calls this class to serialize a LoadoutDefinition into DataOutputStream, including name, color/icon metadata, spellbook/prayer state, skills, equipment-map entries and item entries.
The paired DataInputStream method reconstructs persisted loadout/folder state into the LoadoutFolder model using the matching field order.
The class contains only static binary read/write operations and no file-path ownership; LoadoutPersistence owns the files while this helper owns the binary encoding.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 binary codec delegated to by LoadoutPersistence.

evidence.detail: The single static method immediately returns unless the supplied LoadoutFolder is empty.

When empty, it constructs predefined LoadoutDefinition presets including exact names 'Melee', 'Hybrid (NH)' and 'Pure', populating fixed equipment/item entries, spellbook/prayer metadata and other loadout defaults.
LoadoutsPanel invokes this seeder for loadout folders and passes the live LoadoutPersistence object so the generated defaults are part of the normal persisted loadout lifecycle.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 default preset seeder for an empty loadout folder.

evidence.detail: The class owns a global ConcurrentHashMap<Integer, rs/gui/x>, a fixed five-thread ExecutorService, a five-element LoadoutItemIconLoader array and one round-robin worker index.
R144 LoadoutItemEntry constructs this class from its item id and calls b() to obtain the cached rendered icon.
On cache miss b() selects a worker, submits the item id for icon generation and returns null until the worker populates the shared cache; on hit it memoizes and returns the cached rs/gui/x.
R390 LoadoutsPanel invokes the static initializer method that creates/submits the five loader workers.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 shared item-icon cache used by loadout item entries and panel rendering.
